```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof temp = {
  const container = html`
  <div class="sampler-widget">
    <div class="widget-icon">🌡️</div>
    <div class="widget-label" style="z-index: 5;">TEMP</div>
    <div class="vertical-track" style="z-index: 2;">
      <div class="emoji-hot">💧</div>
      <div class="emoji-cold">❄️</div>
      <div class="frost"></div>
      <div class="thermometer-ticks">
        ${[...Array(6)].map(() => html`<div style="height: 1.5px; width: 4px; background: ${theme.base01};"></div>`)}
      </div>
      <div class="fill thermometer-fill" style="height: 35%; background: linear-gradient(to top, ${theme.blue}, ${theme.red}); z-index: 3;"></div>
      <div class="bulb thermometer-bulb" style="background: ${theme.blue}; z-index: 2;"></div>
      <input type="range" class="vertical-range" min="0.01" max="2" step="0.01" value="0.7" orient="vertical">
    </div>
    <div class="val widget-value-box" style="z-index: 5;">0.70</div>
  </div>`;
  const input = container.querySelector("input");
  const fill = container.querySelector(".fill");
  const bulb = container.querySelector(".bulb");
  const val = container.querySelector(".val");
  const frost = container.querySelector(".frost");
  const hotEmoji = container.querySelector(".emoji-hot");
  const coldEmoji = container.querySelector(".emoji-cold");
  const update = () => {
    const sliderVal = parseFloat(input.value);
    const v = 2.01 - sliderVal;
    const pct = (v / 2) * 100;
    fill.style.height = Math.max(5, pct) + "%";
    hotEmoji.style.opacity = Math.max(0, (v - 1.2) / 0.8);
    hotEmoji.style.top = Math.max(0, (v - 1.2) * 60) + "px";
    coldEmoji.style.opacity = Math.max(0, (0.8 - v) / 0.8);
    if (v < 0.4) {
      fill.style.background = "linear-gradient(to top, " + theme.base3 + ", " + theme.blue + ")";
      bulb.style.background = theme.blue;
      frost.style.background = "rgba(var(--sol-base3-rgb), 0.4)";
      frost.style.backdropFilter = "blur(2px)";
      container.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px " + theme.base3 + ", 0 4px 6px rgba(var(--sol-base03-rgb), 0.4)";
      container.classList.remove("hot-pulse");
      fill.style.boxShadow = "0 0 10px " + theme.base3;
      bulb.style.boxShadow = "0 0 10px " + theme.base3;
    } else if (v > 1.4) {
      fill.style.background = "linear-gradient(to top, " + theme.red + ", " + theme.orange + ")";
      bulb.style.background = theme.red;
      frost.style.background = "transparent";
      frost.style.backdropFilter = "blur(0px)";
      container.classList.add("hot-pulse");
      fill.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px " + theme.red;
      bulb.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px " + theme.red;
    } else {
      fill.style.background = "linear-gradient(to top, " + theme.green + ", " + theme.yellow + ")";
      bulb.style.background = theme.green;
      frost.style.background = "transparent";
      frost.style.backdropFilter = "blur(0px)";
      container.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 6px rgba(var(--sol-base03-rgb), 0.4)";
      container.classList.remove("hot-pulse");
      fill.style.boxShadow = "none";
      bulb.style.boxShadow = "none";
    }
    val.innerText = v.toFixed(2);
    container.value = v;
    container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };
  input.oninput = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); update(); };
  setTimeout(update, 0);
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof topK = {
  const container = html`
  <div class="sampler-widget">
    <div class="aggro-grad" style="background: linear-gradient(to bottom, ${theme.red}66, transparent);"></div>
    <div class="aggro-emoji">💢</div>
    <div class="widget-icon">🪓</div>
    <div class="widget-label" style="z-index: 2;">TOP-K</div>
    <div class="blade-track" style="z-index: 2;">
      <div id="tokens" class="tokens-track">
        ${[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map(i => html`<div class="tok" style="height: 5px; margin: 0 5px; background: ${theme.cyan}; border-radius: 2px; transition: opacity 0.2s, background 0.2s;"></div>`)}
      </div>
      <div class="blade blade-line">
         <div class="blade-icon">🔪</div>
      </div>
      <input type="range" class="vertical-range" min="1" max="8" step="1" value="8" orient="vertical">
    </div>
    <div class="val widget-value-box" style="z-index: 2;">8</div>
  </div>`;
  const input = container.querySelector("input");
  const blade = container.querySelector(".blade");
  const val = container.querySelector(".val");
  const toks = container.querySelectorAll(".tok");
  const aggroGrad = container.querySelector(".aggro-grad");
  const aggroEmoji = container.querySelector(".aggro-emoji");
  const update = () => {
    const v = parseInt(input.value);
    const pct = (v / 8.2) * 100;
    blade.style.top = pct + "%";
    const intensity = Math.max(0, (4 - v) / 3);
    aggroGrad.style.opacity = intensity;
    aggroEmoji.style.opacity = intensity;
    if (intensity > 0) {
      container.style.boxShadow = "0 0 " + (15 * intensity) + "px " + theme.red + "88, 0 4px 6px rgba(var(--sol-base03-rgb), 0.4)";
    } else {
      container.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 6px rgba(var(--sol-base03-rgb), 0.4)";
    }
    toks.forEach((tok, idx) => {
      tok.style.opacity = (idx >= v) ? "0.2" : "1";
      tok.style.background = (idx >= v) ? theme.base01 : theme.cyan;
    });
    val.innerText = v;
    container.value = v;
    container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };
  input.oninput = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); update(); };
  setTimeout(update, 0);
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof topP = {
  const container = html`
  <div class="sampler-widget" style="width: 110px;">
    <div class="widget-icon">🎯</div>
    <div class="widget-label">TOP-P (Nucleus)</div>
    <div class="nucleus-orbit">
      <div class="core nucleus-core" style="background: radial-gradient(circle, ${theme.yellow} 0%, ${theme.orange} 100%); opacity: 0.8;"></div>
      <div class="nucleus-grid" style="background-image: radial-gradient(${theme.base3}22 1px, transparent 1px);"></div>
      <input type="range" class="overlay-range" min="0.1" max="1" step="0.05" value="1">
    </div>
    <div class="val widget-value-box">1.00</div>
  </div>`;
  const input = container.querySelector("input");
  const core = container.querySelector(".core");
  const val = container.querySelector(".val");
  const update = () => {
    const v = parseFloat(input.value);
    const scale = Math.max(0.2, v);
    core.style.transform = "scale(" + scale + ")";
    core.style.opacity = v < 0.3 ? 0.4 : 0.8;
    val.innerText = v.toFixed(2);
    container.value = v;
    container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };
  input.oninput = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); update(); };
  setTimeout(update, 0);
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const vocab = [
    { word: "Intelligence", logit: 8.0 },
    { word: "Chat", logit: 7.5 },
    { word: "Code", logit: 6.0 },
    { word: "Robot", logit: 5.0 },
    { word: "Erreur", logit: 4.0 },
    { word: "Pizza", logit: 1.0 },
    { word: "Soleil", logit: 0.5 },
    { word: "Arbre", logit: 0.1 }
  ];
  const maxLogit = d3.max(vocab, d => d.logit);
  let items = vocab.map(d => ({ ...d, score: Math.exp((d.logit - maxLogit) / temp) }));
  let sumScore = d3.sum(items, d => d.score);
  items.forEach(d => d.prob = d.score / sumScore);
  items.sort((a, b) => b.prob - a.prob);
  items.forEach((d, i) => { if (i >= topK) d.prob = 0; });
  let cumulative = 0;
  let pCutoffReached = false;
  items.forEach(d => {
    if (pCutoffReached || d.prob <= 0) {
      d.prob = 0;
    } else {
      cumulative += d.prob;
      if (cumulative >= topP) pCutoffReached = true;
    }
  });
  let finalSum = d3.sum(items, d => d.prob);
  items.forEach(d => d.prob = finalSum > 0 ? Math.min(1, d.prob / finalSum) : 0);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 400,
    height: 250,
    marginLeft: 80,
    style: { background: "transparent", color: theme.base1 },
    x: { domain: [0, 1], tickFormat: ".0%", label: "Probabilité (%)" },
    y: { label: null, domain: items.map(d => d.word) },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(items, { x: "prob", y: "word", fill: d => d.prob > 0 ? (d.prob > 0.5 ? theme.green : theme.blue) : theme.base02, rx: 4 }),
      Plot.text(items, { x: "prob", y: "word", text: d => d.prob > 0 ? (d.prob * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "Exclu", textAnchor: "start", dx: 5, fill: theme.base1 })
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // 1. Temperature Card
  const tempStatus = temp < 0.4 ? "warning" : (temp > 1.4 ? "success" : "info");
  const tempCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Température</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${tempStatus === 'warning' ? theme.yellow : (tempStatus === 'success' ? theme.orange : theme.blue)};">${temp.toFixed(2)}</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${temp < 0.4
            ? "<b>Déterministe</b>. Distribution pincée, focus sur la logique pure."
            : (temp > 1.4
              ? "<b>Créatif</b>. Distribution aplatie, focus sur l'originalité."
              : "<b>Équilibré</b>. Navigation fluide entre logique et variabilité.")
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: tempStatus });

  // 2. Top-K Card
  const kStatus = topK <= 3 ? "warning" : "info";
  const kCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Top-K (Candidates)</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${theme.cyan};">${topK}</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${topK <= 3
            ? "<b>Cercle Restreint</b>. Seul le haut du panier est autorisé."
            : "<b>Large Éventail</b>. Le modèle explore une plus grande diversité."
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: kStatus });

  // 3. Top-P Card
  const pStatus = topP < 0.6 ? "warning" : "info";
  const pCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Top-P (Nucleus)</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${theme.yellow};">${(topP * 100).toFixed(0)}%</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${topP < 0.6
            ? "<b>Nucleus Serré</b>. On ne garde que le cœur de la probabilité."
            : "<b>Masse Ouverte</b>. La traîne de probabilité est conservée."
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: pStatus });

  return html`<div class="d-flex flex-row gap-3 w-100 flex-wrap">
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${tempCard}</div>
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${kCard}</div>
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${pCard}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
